children: OMNIQ expands Q Shield deployments into Pennsylvania with two municipal agreements supporting vehicle registration enforcement.
Two-year agreements with two Pennsylvania municipalities for Q Shield vehicle registration enforcement.
Deployments include 18 cameras across nine intersections handling ~80,000 vehicles per day (PennDOT data).
Revenue tied to a citation-processing fee model, creating transaction-based recurring revenue potential.
Both projects include a six-month evaluation period and are expected to go live in 2026.
Platform can flag expired/suspended registrations and, at one site, uninsured vehicles; officers retain enforcement control.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
